page.content:
1991 arcade game that created the World Warriors.

How Street Fighter II connects

  • Topic: Street Fighter — Street Fighter II is the game that defined the series' lore.
  • Faction: World Warriors — Street Fighter II introduced the World Warriors as a playable cast.
  • Character: Ryu — Ryu is a starting World Warrior in Street Fighter II.
  • Character: M. Bison — Street Fighter II ends with M. Bison as Shadaloo's final boss.
  • Series: Street Fighter Alpha — Street Fighter Alpha is the prequel line set before Street Fighter II.

What is Street Fighter II?

Street Fighter II (1991) turned a niche first game into the defining fighting-game cast: eight World Warriors, four bosses, special-move inputs, and M. Bison at the top of Shadaloo.

Key threads lead to Street Fighter, World Warriors, Ryu, M. Bison and Street Fighter Alpha.
